audience_decision_value.evidence: The opening tells an executive why the eight service concepts are credible: they are rooted in decisions, data needs, and operating constraints observed from agencies.

source_fidelity.evidence: The revised source lock and sidecar support every quantitative claim: 40+ use cases, eight services, and workshop concepts split 20 aligned to existing cases and six not fully represented.

form_readability.evidence: Four short paragraphs provide an executive-readable progression without meeting-level detail or an exhaustive inventory of use cases.
